title: 2002 AMC 12A Problem 14
statement: For all positive integers \(n,\) let \(f(n) = \log_{2002} n^2.\) Let \[N = f(11) + f(13) + f(14).\] Which of the following relations is true?

solutions.text:
Using \(\log a^2 = 2\log a\) and adding logs, \[ \begin{aligned} N &= \log_{2002} 11^2 + \log_{2002} 13^2 \\ &\quad {}+ \log_{2002} 14^2 \\ &= \log_{2002}(11\cdot 13\cdot 14)^2. \end{aligned} \]

Since \(11\cdot 13\cdot 14 = 2002,\) this is \(\log_{2002} 2002^2 = 2.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
